## About
Stan's Alignment & Brake Service is family owned and operated right here in Aurora, CO. We work on a wide range of makes and models, foreign and domestic, and we specialize in alignments on just about any kind of vehicle.
Our neighbors come to us for straight answers. One reviewer took a car with a serious vibration to the dealer and the tire shop with no fix, then brought it to us. We found the inner foam lining had come loose and rebalanced the wheels. We're licensed, certified and insured for your protection and peace of mind.
We're rated 4.5 on Google from 463 reviews. If the service you need isn't listed here, give us a call and we'll be glad to help you out.

## Services
- Alignment: Alignments on just about any kind of vehicle.
- Auto Repair: Full service automotive repair for all foreign and domestic vehicles.
- Auto Maintenance: Regular maintenance so you can enjoy more driving time in your vehicle.
- Computer diagnostics: Computer diagnostics on various types of vehicles.
- Tire change and balancing: One reviewer brought a car in for a tire change and balancing and plans to keep coming back.
- Fleet services: We service fleets such as limousine companies, garage door companies and landscaping companies.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:30 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Do you offer a shuttle?
A: Yes, we offer a free shuttle service when it's available. Call ahead to check.

Q: Is there a place to wait?
A: Our waiting area is small with limited seating. One reviewer noted the closest coffee shop is about 5 blocks east on Colfax.

Q: Do you work on foreign cars?
A: Yes. We work on all foreign and domestic vehicles across a wide range of makes and models.

Q: What if the service I need isn't listed?
A: Give us a call and we'll be glad to help you out.

The experience from phone call to talking with them in the shop to getting my car serviced left me happy enough to leave a review! 10/10 lil business" (Leo Miku, 5/5)
- "Yesterday I brought my car in for a tire change and balancing. Afterward I noticed the pressure sensors weren’t working properly, so I came back today. The diagnosis was that one sensor was faulty, but they replaced it at no extra cost and everything is working great now. I really appreciate their honesty and responsibility. You can tell they have experience and provide great service. I will definitely keep bringing my car here." (Luis Andres Cortes, 5/5)
- "Had a serious vibration on my 2018 Chrysler 300 took it to the dealer with no resolution then to where I bought the tires and again no solution. Took it to Stan's and they found the inner foam lining to dampen road noise had come loose. It was creating a serious imbalance. They fixed the problem and check and rebalanced all four wheel. Great team will take it to them from here on." (Arthur Gest, 5/5)
